premise: Duckling sees the moon floating in the pond and tries to scoop it up — it wobbles away every time; Owl wakes and tells him to look up, Firefly adds a second little light to the water, and Duckling falls asleep with the moon watching over him.
inspiration: The monkeys who tried to catch the moon in the well (Indian and Chinese folk), turned: nobody falls in, and the moon is loveliest left where it is — up in the sky and down in the pond at once.
lesson: Some lovely things are for looking at, not keeping.

en-US.title: Duckling Catches the Moon
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] The sun was going down. Up on a branch, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Owl had slept all day, and he was {owl:live doze hold} still fast asleep. {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to pond} Duckling waddled over for one last paddle. {canvas:night 0.8} Then up came the moon. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] "A moon IN the pond! I'll catch it!" {duckling:go to pond another by swim} Off he paddled. {duckling:live scoop} He scooped with his beak… {sfx:splash} splish! The moon wobbled to pieces. {duckling:face sad} Then, little by little, it came back. He tried again… {sfx:splash} {duckling:spray} SPLASH! Gone again. {owl:live doze resume} Owl opened one eye, then the other. {sfx:hoot} "Hoo? What's all the splashing?" {duckling:pulse} "I'm catching the moon!" {owl:face happy} [giggles] {owl:live talk} "Look up," said Owl. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:sparkle} There it was! Up in the sky AND down in the pond! {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to pond} Firefly came drifting down to look, and {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} glowed over the water like a little lantern. Now there were two lights in the pond, a big one and a little one. {duckling:face sleeping} Duckling yawned, and {duckling:live nap hold} tucked his head under his wing. [whispers] And the moon stayed right where it was… and watched him sleep.

es-ES.title: Patito quiere coger la luna
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] El sol se estaba poniendo. En una rama, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Búho había dormido todo el día, y {owl:live doze hold} seguía dormido como un lirón. {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to pond} Patito llegó a la charca para el último chapuzón. {canvas:night 0.8} Entonces salió la luna. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] —¡Hay una luna DENTRO de la charca! ¡Voy a cogerla! {duckling:go to pond another by swim} Y allá fue, nadando. {duckling:live scoop} Intentó pescarla con el pico… {sfx:splash} ¡chof! La luna se hizo mil pedacitos temblorosos. {duckling:face sad} Pero, poco a poco, volvió a juntarse. Otra vez… {sfx:splash} {duckling:spray} ¡CHOF! Nada. {owl:live doze resume} Búho abrió un ojo, y luego el otro. {sfx:hoot} —¿Uuu? ¿A qué viene tanto chapoteo? {duckling:pulse} —¡Estoy cogiendo la luna! {owl:face happy} [giggles] {owl:live talk} —Mira hacia arriba —dijo Búho. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:sparkle} ¡Allí estaba! ¡Arriba en el cielo Y abajo en la charca! {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to pond} Luciérnaga bajó a curiosear y {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} brilló sobre el agua como un farolillo. Ahora había dos luces en la charca: una grande y otra chiquitita. {duckling:face sleeping} Patito bostezó y {duckling:live nap hold} escondió la cabeza bajo el ala. [whispers] Y la luna se quedó donde estaba… mirándolo dormir.

ja-JP.title: アヒルの子と おつきさま
ja-JP.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7}[softly]おひさまが、しずんでいきます。えだの上の{owl:enter}{owl:go to branches}フクロウくんは、一日じゅうねむって、{owl:live doze hold}まだぐっすり。{duckling:enter}{duckling:go to pond}アヒルの子が、さいごのひとおよぎに、池へよちよち。{canvas:night 0.8}やがて、おつきさまがのぼりました。{duckling:face surprised}[gasps]「池のなかに、おつきさま！つかまえよう！」 {duckling:go to pond another by swim}すいすいおよいで、{duckling:live scoop}くちばしで、すくって…{sfx:splash}ちゃぽん！おつきさまは、ゆらゆらばらばら。{duckling:face sad}でも、すこしずつ、もとどおり。もういちど…{sfx:splash}{duckling:spray}ばしゃーん！また、きえちゃった。{owl:live doze resume}フクロウくんが、かためをあけて、もうかためも。{sfx:hoot}「ホー？なんのさわぎだい？」 {duckling:pulse}「おつきさま、つかまえてるの！」 {owl:face happy}[giggles]{owl:live talk}「上を見てごらん」 とフクロウくん。{duckling:face happy}{duckling:sparkle}あった！おそらにも、池のなかにも！{firefly:enter}{firefly:go to pond}ホタルさんが、ふわりと見にきて、{firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A}ちょうちんみたいに、ぽうっ。池には、大きなあかりと、小さなあかり。{duckling:face sleeping}アヒルの子は、ふわあとあくび。{duckling:live nap hold}つばさにあたまをうずめました。[whispers]おつきさまは、そこにいて…ねむるアヒルの子を、見まもっていました。

de-DE.title: Das Entchen fängt den Mond
de-DE.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] Die Sonne ging unter. Oben auf einem Ast hatte {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} die Eule den ganzen Tag geschlafen und {owl:live doze hold} schlief noch immer. {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to pond} Das Entchen watschelte zum Teich, für eine letzte Runde. {canvas:night 0.8} Dann ging der Mond auf. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] „Ein Mond IM Teich! Den fang ich!“ {duckling:go to pond another by swim} Schon paddelte es los. {duckling:live scoop} Es schnappte mit dem Schnabel… {sfx:splash} platsch! Der Mond zerfiel in wackelige Stückchen. {duckling:face sad} Doch langsam kam er zurück. Noch mal… {sfx:splash} {duckling:spray} PLATSCH! Wieder weg. {owl:live doze resume} Die Eule öffnete ein Auge, dann das andere. {sfx:hoot} „Schuhu? Wer plantscht denn hier so?“ {duckling:pulse} „Ich fange den Mond!“ {owl:face happy} [giggles] {owl:live talk} „Schau nach oben“, sagte die Eule. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:sparkle} Da war er! Oben am Himmel UND unten im Teich! {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to pond} Das Glühwürmchen schwebte neugierig herab und {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} leuchtete über dem Wasser wie eine kleine Laterne. Jetzt waren zwei Lichter im Teich, ein großes und ein kleines. {duckling:face sleeping} Das Entchen gähnte und {duckling:live nap hold} steckte den Kopf unter den Flügel. [whispers] Und der Mond blieb, wo er war… und sah ihm beim Schlafen zu.

fr-FR.title: Caneton attrape la lune
fr-FR.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] Le soleil se couchait. Sur une branche, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Hibou avait dormi toute la journée, et {owl:live doze hold} il dormait toujours. {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to pond} Caneton est venu barboter une dernière fois. {canvas:night 0.8} Puis la lune s’est levée. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] « Une lune DANS la mare ! Je vais l’attraper ! » {duckling:go to pond another by swim} Et hop, à la nage ! {duckling:live scoop} Il a plongé le bec… {sfx:splash} plic ! La lune a tremblé en mille morceaux. {duckling:face sad} Puis, petit à petit, elle est revenue. Il a recommencé… {sfx:splash} {duckling:spray} PLOUF ! Encore partie. {owl:live doze resume} Hibou a ouvert un œil, puis l’autre. {sfx:hoot} « Hou ? C’est quoi, tout ce plouf-plouf ? » {duckling:pulse} « J’attrape la lune ! » {owl:face happy} [giggles] {owl:live talk} « Lève les yeux », a dit Hibou. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:sparkle} Elle était là ! Dans le ciel ET dans la mare ! {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to pond} Luciole est descendue voir et {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} a brillé sur l’eau comme une petite lanterne. Maintenant, deux lumières brillaient dans la mare : une grande et une toute petite. {duckling:face sleeping} Caneton a bâillé et {duckling:live nap hold} a mis la tête sous l’aile. [whispers] Et la lune est restée là où elle était… à le regarder dormir.

it-IT.title: Anatroccolo vuole prendere la luna
it-IT.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] Il sole stava tramontando. Su un ramo, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Gufo aveva dormito tutto il giorno, e {owl:live doze hold} dormiva ancora della grossa. {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to pond} Anatroccolo è arrivato allo stagno per un'ultima nuotatina. {canvas:night 0.8} Poi è sorta la luna. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] «Una luna DENTRO lo stagno! La prendo io!» {duckling:go to pond another by swim} E via, a nuotare. {duckling:live scoop} Ha provato a pescarla col becco… {sfx:splash} splish! La luna si è rotta in tanti pezzetti tremolanti. {duckling:face sad} Poi, piano piano, è tornata intera. Ci ha riprovato… {sfx:splash} {duckling:spray} SPLASH! Sparita di nuovo. {owl:live doze resume} Gufo ha aperto un occhio, poi l'altro. {sfx:hoot} «Uuh? Cos'è tutto questo sguazzare?» {duckling:pulse} «Sto prendendo la luna!» {owl:face happy} [giggles] {owl:live talk} «Guarda in su», ha detto Gufo. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:sparkle} Eccola lì! Su nel cielo E giù nello stagno! {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to pond} Lucciola è scesa piano piano a guardare, e {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} si è accesa sopra l'acqua come una piccola lanterna. Adesso nello stagno c'erano due luci, una grande e una piccina. {duckling:face sleeping} Anatroccolo ha sbadigliato e {duckling:live nap hold} ha infilato la testa sotto l'ala. [whispers] E la luna è rimasta lì dov'era… a guardarlo dormire.

zh-TW.title: 小鴨撈月亮
zh-TW.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7}[softly]太陽要下山了。高高的樹枝上，{owl:enter}{owl:go to branches}貓頭鷹睡了一整天，{owl:live doze hold}現在還在呼呼大睡。{duckling:enter}{duckling:go to pond}小鴨搖搖擺擺地走到池塘，想再游最後一圈。{canvas:night 0.8}這時，月亮升起來了。{duckling:face surprised}[gasps]「池塘裡有一個月亮！我要把它撈起來！」 {duckling:go to pond another by swim}牠划呀划，游了過去。{duckling:live scoop}用嘴巴一撈……{sfx:splash}嘩啦！月亮碎成好多片，晃呀晃。{duckling:face sad}慢慢的，它又拼回來了。小鴨再試一次……{sfx:splash}{duckling:spray}嘩啦啦！又不見了。{owl:live doze resume}貓頭鷹睜開一隻眼睛，又睜開另一隻。{sfx:hoot}「咕？是誰在那裡嘩啦嘩啦的？」 {duckling:pulse}「我在撈月亮！」 {owl:face happy}[giggles]{owl:live talk}「抬頭看看。」 貓頭鷹說。{duckling:face happy}{duckling:sparkle}月亮在那裡！天上有一個，池塘裡也有一個！{firefly:enter}{firefly:go to pond}螢火蟲輕輕飄下來看，{firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A}在水面上亮著，像一盞小燈籠。現在，池塘裡有兩個亮光了，一個大的，一個小的。{duckling:face sleeping}小鴨打了個呵欠，{duckling:live nap hold}把頭埋進翅膀底下。[whispers]月亮就一直待在那裡……靜靜地看著牠睡覺。

zh-HK.title: 小鴨撈月光
zh-HK.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7}[softly]太陽快要下山了。高高的樹枝上，{owl:enter}{owl:go to branches}貓頭鷹睡了一整天，{owl:live doze hold}到現在還睡得正香。{duckling:enter}{duckling:go to pond}小鴨一搖一擺地走到池塘，想再游最後一圈。{canvas:night 0.8}這時，月亮升起來了。{duckling:face surprised}[gasps]「池塘入面有個月光！等我撈佢上嚟！」 {duckling:go to pond another by swim}牠划呀划，游了過去。{duckling:live scoop}牠用嘴巴一撈……{sfx:splash}嘩啦！月亮碎成一片片，晃呀晃。{duckling:face sad}慢慢地，它又拼回來了。小鴨再試一次……{sfx:splash}{duckling:spray}嘩啦啦！又不見了。{owl:live doze resume}貓頭鷹睜開一隻眼睛，再睜開另一隻。{sfx:hoot}「咕？邊個喺度嘩啦嘩啦咁㗎？」 {duckling:pulse}「我撈緊月光呀！」 {owl:face happy}[giggles]{owl:live talk}「抬頭望吓啦。」 貓頭鷹說。{duckling:face happy}{duckling:sparkle}月亮在那裏！天上有一個，池塘裏也有一個！{firefly:enter}{firefly:go to pond}螢火蟲輕輕飄到池塘上看，{firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A}在水面上亮着，像一盞小燈籠。現在，池塘裏有兩點光了，一點大，一點小。{duckling:face sleeping}小鴨打了個呵欠，{duckling:live nap hold}把頭藏進翅膀底下。[whispers]月亮一直留在那裏……靜靜地看着牠睡覺。

splash.prompt: a duckling's beak dipping into a still pond, a small soft splash, realistic
